utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still keeping the supply list updated—tell me what’s already been gathered, and I’ll keep an eye on the start time too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve got a few hand tools ready to lend, and I can bring them by once we know what’s still needed. Just tell me what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’d start with the repair drive details, please—just the first item is fine. Thanks, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ve got a running list of what we still need for the repair drive. Just tell me what’s been gathered so far, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — could you help figure out the pickup and drop-off logistics? I’m a little worried about timing and making sure everything gets where it needs to go.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with the pickup and drop-off. What time do you need me there, and should I bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m ready to help. Put me wherever you need the most hands, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam — that’s great to hear. I’ll check what needs doing most and circle back with a task for you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, okay — can you confirm which tools you actually have available?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still watching for the setup spot, but I don’t have the tool list yet. I’ll let you know the exact location as soon as I see it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, that’s great to hear—I’d love the details if you can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll keep an eye out for where they set up the repair drive and let you know the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll double-check the repair drive details first. What’s the first item you want me to look at?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, thanks — could you confirm the exact spot and start time for the repair drive? I can jump in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still just hearing second-hand, but sounds like it’s coming up soon and staying pretty low-key. If there’s a set plan, I’d love the latest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s shaping up nicely—people are already dropping off all sorts of repairs. If you want, I can pass along the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll keep an eye out and let you know the exact spot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—just point me to the exact spot, and I’ll check it carefully first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s coming up soon — I’m just waiting on the final details and drop-off time. I’ll let you know as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh nice, that’s good to hear. Just let me know when the drop-off time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rosa, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or swing by with the details?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — please spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center now. If you can swing by with the details, that’d be great too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s been gathered so far for the repair drive, and can you let me know the start time when you have it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’ve got the repair drive moving along, and I’ll let you know the start time as soon as it’s set. I’ll keep it low-key and repeat the plan to everyone once everything’s ready.
